newsitem.title: USA: CME July pork bellies up limit, light deliveries.
newsitem.headline: CME July pork bellies up limit, light deliveries.

text.p: July CME pork bellies futures moved up for a limit gain of 3.000 cents per lb as light deliveries and talk of bottoming action in cash continued to lift prices into buy stops, traders said.
July rose the limit to 81.675 cents with other months up 2.875 to 1.500 cents with August up to 80.375.

Deliveries have been much lighter than expected against the July contract and strong stoppers have taken most of them. The cash belly market is also expected to bottom after recently falling $10 per cwt, they said.
